## 任务：检查 plan-004 训练进度 + 诊断 OOM

服务器：autodl-5090 (root@autodl-5090)
项目路径：/root/gen-depth-fingerprint

```bash
ps -p 138847 -o pid,cmd,etime 2>/dev/null && echo "GPU1_ALIVE" || echo "GPU1_DEAD"
ps -p 139215 -o pid,cmd,etime 2>/dev/null && echo "GPU3_ALIVE" || echo "GPU3_DEAD"

```bash
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader

tail -50 /tmp/plan004_gpu1.log

```bash
wc -l /root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/qwen3-8b/generations_shard0.jsonl 2>/dev/null

```
